verdict.rationale: Mistral's own pricing page states 'you can self-host our models anywhere'. It also documents open-weight models such as Mistral Small 4 under Apache 2.0, with a Model weights page offering download links. Community users confirm local and self-hosted deployment, for example Devstral running locally. Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosting deployment documentation in the pack, clarity on commercial licensing (production use requires a separate Mistral license), and self-hosting of platform features like Agents and Document Library, which are described as Mistral Cloud tools.
